info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizdriftdoc-List Hotel Rooms Pricings-v1-spec
info.description: The Hotel Room Pricing API provides access to current pricing information for various hotel rooms. This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed pricing for available rooms, which is essential for comparing options and making informed booking decisions. Typical consumers include travel agencies, booking platforms, and end-users looking for the best accommodation deals. The API ensures timely updates on pricing, enhancing transparency and efficiency in the hotel booking process.
